headline: Discussed grant deadlines, music series plans, and project leads for next year; approved October minutes.
summary: Grant applications are due December 31, and letters are going out to past applicants. Members discussed next year's music series, including streamlining communications and possibly moving the work to Arts or DNA. Commissioners also signed up to lead or support projects for fiscal 2027.

decision_evidence.quote: Approval of Minutes October 2026: Motion by Laurie, Paula, approved unanimously

plain_text:
NASHUA ARTS COMMISSION 
Tuesday, November 10th at 8am 
3rd Floor Auditorium 
Nashua City Hall 
229 Main Street, Nashua NH 03060 
 
Attendees: Lindsay, Chuck, Laurie, Mike, Paula, Jenn, Faith, Sara, Jane 
Absent: Tina, Stephanie (both planned)  
Guests: Liz (notetaker), Jonathan Gonzalez (flow free or die), Anthony Cetoni (NCC 
student) 
 
ARTS COMMISSION WORK TO HAVE COMPLETED PRIOR TO THIS MEETING: 
 
● Review drafted project calendar here and master brainstorm list and choose at 
least 1 project you'd like to be actively involved in and a secondary project or 
interest 
● Identify anything we missed and bring up at next meeting 
● Review NAC Arts & Culture Plan and match your preferred project to an initiative 
in the plan and consider the "why"/impact 
 
MINUTES 
8:00am Call To Order 
Roll Call of Members  
Welcome Guests 
Approval of Minutes October 2026: Motion by Laurie, Paula, approved 
unanimously 
8:05am Grant Committee Report (Laurie), grants due December 31, letters are 
going out shortly to previous applicants, and live on website at same time, need to 
vote for new grant committee chair in subcommittee 
8:10am Old Business 
● Discuss FY26 Music Series (Faith)  
• recommendations for next year: streamlining communications and 
maybe separating the execution into either Arts or DNA entirely. We 
can pay the musicians directly if we contract them ahead of time.
● NEA Economic Impact Webinar (Sara)  
• Sara attended webinar that might have a cost reduction/answered 
survey option, and no set date yet for a start. Potentially asking for 
partnership with NCA Committee and DIC for help funding and/or 
distributing surveys 
● FY27 Priorities and Project Planning/Adoption  
• each commissioner is asked to take on a leadership role for a project or officer 
role with the committee and a secondary project/role 
• 3 main projects: Grants, Succession planning, resolution to make funding 
permanent for Commission 
• Committee reviewed options for projects for the year 
• Chuck interested in NEA Survey and ArtWalk 
• Faith interested in chairing Music Series, ArtWalk, plus possible arts 
magazine (example: Londonderryartscouncil.com), grants committee 
• Jane interested in Children’s Art Show, grants committee 
• Paula interested in Children’s Art Show, qr code project 
• Laurie chairing grants committee, qr codes for public art, music series 
• Sara on grants committee, literacy project (author advertising in 
downtown business windows- may connect with Arts Magazine idea) 
working with library/United Way, Qr Code project, NEA Project 
• Lindsay interested in succession planning, resolution draft  
• Stephanie interested music series, cultural events calendar OR 
children’s art show 
• Mike interested in music series, children’s art show 
• Jenn helping with succession planning until January, provide old 
documentation from Distrix app for QR Code project 
 
9:05am Call To Artist Notices (if any) 
Upcoming Event Announcements (if any) 
Main Street UnWrapped this Saturday  
Veterans Day Parade on Wednesday at 11am 
Winter Stroll November 28 
SBA – Historic Society, Renaissance Glassworks visits? 
Lots of concerts at NCMS in the next few weeks 
Activate Nashua Academy in February/March 
Open Discussion for Commissioners (if time allows) none
ACTION ITEM for Commissioners prior to next meeting:  
Review your chosen projects and consider: 
1. Did we make any mistakes? Are you missing from a project or added to the 
wrong one? If so, please let us know! 
2. If you haven't volunteered to take the lead on a project yet, which project would 
you like to lead? 
3. If you'd like to take the lead on a project and need training, please let Lindsay 
know. She'd be DELIGHTED to help train you! 
4. We added a few projects outside of the current calendar (Literacy project, Arts 
Calendar, and Magazine). Where should we fit these in this year? 
 
Motion to adjourn at 9:21am by Chuck, seconded by Paula, approved unanimously 
 
Next Meeting: Tuesday, December 8th, 2026 at 8am in City Auditorium of Nashua 
City Hall
